entities.name: Bant
entities.description: One of the five shards of Alara, primarily white-aligned with green and blue, a haven of order, honor and community ruled in spirit by angels.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of five shards, of which Bant is one; later reunited as New Alara.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: Bant's former supreme queen of the angels, who gave her life fighting the demon Malfegor long ago.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A demon Asha fought and died fighting.

entities.name: Rafiq
entities.description: Bant's Knight-General, awarded multiple sigils and warned by Tezzeret of the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker awarded the Sigil of Valor.

entities.name: Gwafa Hazid
entities.description: Leader of the Grand Caravan, who destroyed Giltspire Castle.

entities.name: Lisha
entities.description: A member of the royal family of Jhess rumored to bestow the Smile of Jhess on paragons.

entities.name: Mubin
entities.description: Defeated in the arena by Rafiq to resolve a dispute between ship patrols and island aven.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who sent a warning message to Rafiq during the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor whose Machine Legion targets Alara.

entities.name: Angels of Bant
entities.description: Mortals who died on the shard and reformed as angels, organized in four ranks, guiding mortals without interfering directly.

entities.name: Knightly orders of Bant
entities.description: The orders of knights active in all nations of Bant, including the Olive Branch, the Order of the Skyward Eye and the Order of the White Orchid.

entities.name: Grand Caravan
entities.description: The world's greatest convoy of leotau-pulled trade carts, led by Gwafa Hazid.

entities.name: Unbeholden
entities.description: Thieves and rogues of Bant who reject or fall outside the caste system.

entities.name: Machine Legion
entities.description: Elesh Norn's army that strikes Bant, Esper and Jund.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event during which red mana from Naya and black mana from Esper flooded into Bant, shattering its society.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which Elesh Norn's Machine Legion strikes Alara.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: A force that awoke to fight on behalf of Alara during the invasion.

entities.name: Sigils
entities.description: Coinlike magical medallions of honor and patronage that empower their wearers.

entities.name: Sword of Asha
entities.description: A sword with a sigil of Asha in its crossguard, once buried at the Twelve Trees of Valeron.

entities.name: Cathedral of Bliss
entities.description: A vast temple of glowing marble floating high in the sky, ruled by Asha's angels.

entities.name: Giltspire Castle
entities.description: Akrasa's largest castle, destroyed by Gwafa Hazid, now the site of the Obelisk of Bant.

entities.name: Serul Cove
entities.description: A coastal city where rogues peddle stolen sigils.

entities.name: Jhess
entities.description: Bant's island nation with the most Unbeholden.

events.summary: Long ago a council of archmages enchants Bant so that mortals who die there can reform as angels.
events.quote: Long ago, a council of archmages put a complex enchantment on Bant, allowing mortals who died on the shard to reform as angels.

events.summary: Archangel Asha, ruler of Bant, gives her life fighting the demon Malfegor; no angel assumes her title afterward.
events.quote: who gave her life fighting the demon Malfegor long ago

events.summary: Rafiq is awarded the Sigil of the Salted Wind for resolving a dispute by defeating Mubin in the arena.
events.quote: awarded to Rafiq for resolving a dispute between the ship patrols and the island aven by defeating Mubin in the arena

events.summary: Gwafa Hazid destroys Giltspire Castle in Akrasa.
events.quote: which was destroyed by Gwafa Hazid

events.summary: During the Conflux, red mana from Naya and black mana from Esper flood into Bant, and the Order of the Skyward Eye sows mistrust and panic.
events.quote: During the Conflux, red mana from Naya and black mana from Esper flooded into Bant, creating havoc.

events.summary: Creatures from Grixis and Jund slaughter settlements and Bant's angels lose control as society collapses.
events.quote: The angels no longer could keep Bant under firm control

events.summary: Bant's borders merge with the other shards until it becomes part of New Alara; its castles lie in ruin.
events.quote: Its borders merged more and more with the other shards until it became part of New Alara.

events.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion strikes Bant, Esper and Jund as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund

events.summary: Tezzeret warns Rafiq to employ the angels against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Tezzeret sent a warning message to Rafiq

events.summary: During the invasion the Maelstrom awakens to fight on behalf of Alara.
events.quote: the Maelstrom itself awoke to fight on behalf of Alara

It is led by Gwafa Hazid
